blocked_r5_3.source: prior user-visible task result; no R5.3 artifact or production edit exists

allowed_information: released measured pump speed and timestamp
qualified static actuator and sensor profile

terminology.tracking_epoch: causal interval assessing response to a qualified material command demand
terminology.unresolved_demand_age: elapsed time from the first unresolved material demand; ordinary PLC ticks may not reset it

frozen_r5_2_rules.scope: diagnostic initial handoff in generic numerical fixture only

proposed_epoch_constraints.start: only qualified material demand when no unresolved epoch exists
proposed_epoch_constraints.small_same_direction: retain original start and fault-evidence age
proposed_epoch_constraints.material_same_direction: retain original start; latest command may change, but unresolved age cannot reset
proposed_epoch_constraints.material_reversal: close old directional context and establish a new one; anti-reset policy remains unresolved
proposed_epoch_constraints.completion: requires qualified measured tracking, not elapsed time alone
proposed_epoch_constraints.replacement: must not erase unresolved fault evidence merely because PLC command changes
proposed_epoch_constraints.steady_monitoring: new material demands must be evaluated after earlier progress
proposed_epoch_constraints.progress_loss: must return to qualification; exact guard unresolved
proposed_epoch_constraints.recovery: suspected requires qualified measured progress; confirmed cannot clear top-level FAULT
proposed_epoch_constraints.measurement_invalid: INSUFFICIENT_MEASUREMENT and existing sensor-quality Safety path; do not fabricate tracking confirmation
proposed_epoch_constraints.response_window: derive from typed delay, lag, ramp, sensor sample/release timing and qualified measurement resolution; calibration dependency must be audited before validation

acceptance: all S1-S16 and all eight formal invariants pass under a fully specified parameterized rule; no forbidden input or production-source modification
pre_validation_stop_conditions: reversal or chatter can mask stuck
